convert_nlc_to_nchw: convert an NLC shape tensor to NCHW shape tensor using nlc_to_nchw with hw_shape
convert_nchw_to_nlc: flatten an NCHW shape tensor to NLC shape tensor using nchw_to_nlc
apply_module_nchw2nlc2nchw: apply a module like LayerNorm to an NCHW tensor via nchw2nlc2nchw shape conversion
apply_module_nlc2nchw2nlc: apply a module like Conv2d to an NLC tensor via nlc2nchw2nlc shape conversion
review_shape_convert_utils: review the shape_convert module functions for tensor shape conversion between NLC and NCHW
